collection.title: Formula Mnemonics & Memory Anchors
collection.description: High-retention memory anchors, acronyms, and visual hooks for physics formulas and chemistry rules.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: **FONClBrISCCH**: Fluorine > Oxygen > Nitrogen > Chlorine > Bromine > Iodine > Sulfur > Carbon > Carbon > Hydrogen. Memory Hook: *"Phone Call Brought I-S-C-C-H"*.

metadata.application: Determining bond polarity and hydrogen bonding eligibility (F, O, N only).

items.subject: Physics
items.body: **R-M-I-V-U-X-G**: Radio > Microwave > Infrared > Visible > Ultraviolet > X-ray > Gamma ray (Increasing Frequency). Hook: *"Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns"*.

metadata.hook: Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns

items.subject: Mathematics
items.body: **ASTC (All Silver Tea Cups / All Students Take Calculus)**: Quadrant I: All positive; Quadrant II: Sin & Csc; Quadrant III: Tan & Cot; Quadrant IV: Cos & Sec.

items.subject: Chemistry
items.body: **EDG = Ortho/Para, EWG = Meta**: Electron Donating Groups direct to Ortho & Para; Electron Withdrawing Groups (containing multiple bonds or positive charge on atom attached to ring) direct to Meta. Exception: Halogens (deactivating but o/p directing).

metadata.hook: Donors Love Outside (Ortho/Para), Withdrawers Stay Middle (Meta)

items.subject: Physics
items.body: **BB ROY of Great Britain had a Very Good Wife**: Black (0), Brown (1), Red (2), Orange (3), Yellow (4), Green (5), Blue (6), Violet (7), Grey (8), White (9). Gold (±5%), Silver (±10%).

metadata.hook: BB ROY of Great Britain had a Very Good Wife
